violation_type.title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §746.4505)
violation_type.typical_finding: There was no storage space for each child's person belongings in the infant room, two toddler rooms, and pre-k room.

finding_variants.text: There was no storage space for each child's person belongings in the infant room, two toddler rooms, and pre-k room.

Cubbies in the gymnasium, science lab and CCLC Imaginarium classrooms were observed without children's name labeled on them.     This was corrected when the operation placed labels with children names on the cubbies inside each room.
Based on information provided during the investigation inspection and interviews there is sufficient evidence to conclude that all children do not have storage for their belongings.
The infant classroom does not have proper storage for the children's belongings.
The after school room was observed and individual storage for children's belongings was not available.
In the infant classroom, children's storage for belongings were not labeled.     This was corrected at inspection when caregivers labeled storage area with children's names.
